def get_orders_with_items(order_ids):
    orders = []
    for oid in order_ids:
        order = db.query(f'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id={oid}')
        items = db.query(f'SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id={oid}')
        order['items'] = items
        orders.append(order)
    return orders

gold_review.explanation: The answer field is a terse label ("O(n^2)"), while all four reward terms are keyword/section heuristics over a full write-up (BOTTLENECK/COMPLEXITY/FIX/EXPECTED IMPROVEMENT, bottleneck-type and fix keywords, code fences), so echoing the label earns only the O(...) specificity bit (0.14). Note the grader is pure keyword matching (a reply stuffing "cpu loop o(n set hash dict ```" scores high without being right).
